propositions: _paged_search loop has no offset-stall guard and spins forever (26+ calls observed) when a DC server ignores/repeats startAt, returning the same page repeatedly
get_parent_map and three fetch_snapshot enrichment handlers swallow any error from _paged_search via broad except Exception handlers, converting a stall abort into silent empty results
_paged_search must raise BackendPaginationStallError in core when a page repeats the previous page's first issue key (ANY repeated page, short or full), indicating the server is not honouring startAt
Stall error must be re-raised ahead of all four broad exception handlers (get_parent_map, fetcher.py lines 621/668/708) to propagate the signal rather than degrade the snapshot
Well-behaved page-capping DC servers that honor startAt must continue recovering full 250-issue results through all three whole-project readers unchanged
